summary: Brookfield Corporation filed a Form 6-K containing its interim report to shareholders for Q2 2026, including MD&A and unaudited consolidated financial statements, plus certifications. The filing is a routine periodic report by a foreign private issuer, incorporating results into registration statements. No special-situation event (acquisition, divestiture, tender, restructuring, etc.) is described. The filing is purely routine disclosure of financial results, with no transaction terms, board recommendations, advisors, or structural details. As such, it does not qualify as a special situation and is classified as None.
